profile.headline: Software Developer | Programmer | Full Stack Engineer | Solidity | Javascript | Python
profile.summary: A Full Stack Developer Python, React and Solidity. Experience building web applications with backend API Systems.

positions.title: Web Developer / System Administrator
positions.description:
• Develop, design, and apply security patches to website. 
• Streamline content creation and management.
• Migrate website to AWS lightsail which resulted in an increase of traffic, improved navigation and cut cost.

Key Technologies Used: Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP, Javascript, HTML, CSS3, HTML5, PHP, AWS and Wordpress CMS

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
GoHighflier is a Los Angeles-based Shopify Partner agency for fashion and beauty brands. We design, build, and maintain Shopify stores, plus the email and conversion work that keeps them selling.

• Lead Shopify design and custom development, from strategy and UX/UI design to custom theme builds.
• Build Klaviyo and Mailchimp email and SMS flows, campaigns, and segments that drive repeat purchases.
• Run conversion rate optimization on product pages, cart, and checkout, measured against orders and revenue.
• Manage ongoing store operations and maintenance for client brands.
• Set business goals, operating procedures, budgets, and technology strategy.

Key Technologies Used: Shopify, Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Klaviyo, Mailchimp

positions.title: Software Developer / Citrix Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Automate receiving and sending SOX and PCI compliance data securely via SFTP, CA AutoSys and Powershell. Saving roughly 3 man hours per month.
• Develop a monitoring tool to watch realtime network drive changes that reduces unauthorized access to folders and files by 80 percent. Which utilize Python and Watchdog API. 
• Create terminal applications to resolve 90 percent of reoccurring user issues.
• Develop a clean up tool to delete business data after 30 days has passed and emails IT after completion. Saving 2 man hours per month.

Key Technologies Used: Python, Powershell, HTML5, CSS3, AutoSys

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
• Worked within an engagement team and managed VMware ESXI host. 
• Increased firm security implementing Applocker rules. 
• Automated laptop imaging to increase productivity.

Key Technologies Used: Powershell, VMware Vsphere, VMware ESXi and Applocker
